text:
```yaml
name: Bundle Analyzer

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Generate bundle analyzer
        run: pnpm run build:analyze

      - name: Upload analyzer reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bundle-analyzer-report
          path: |
            build/**
            dist/**

      - name: Upload pnpm lockfile
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pnpm-lockfile
          path: pnpm-lock.yaml
```
